step1_figure.circuit_type: Common-Source Amplifier with Current-Source Load and Self-Biasing Feedback
step1_figure.description: The core stage is the self-biased common-source amplifier shown in Fig. 21.21 (page 675, with current-source load biased by the wide-swing cascode bias circuit SUB_1 from Fig. 20.43 and AC-coupled input with large self-biasing feedback resistor R1). The netlist cascades this CS stage (xma, xmc) into a second CS gain stage (xmb, xmd) with Miller compensation capacitor Cc1 and load capacitance Cload.

stage1_voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency small-signal voltage gain of the first common-source amplifier stage

equation.explanation: Voltage gain is the total small-signal parallel resistance at the drain node divided by resistance in the source (1/gm1).
equation.assumptions: Both input NMOS and PMOS current-source load are biased in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: With I_D = 20 uA, W/L = 10u/1u for NMOS: g_m1 = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 20u) = 328.6 uA/V. Output resistances with lambda = 0.1 V^-1: r_on = 1/(0.1 * 20u) = 500 kOhm; r_op = 1/(0.1 * 20u) = 500 kOhm. r_out1 = r_on || r_op = 250 kOhm. A_v1 = 328.6u * 250k = 82.2 V/V = 38.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Channel length modulation and PDK velocity saturation lower effective ro and gm slightly compared to ideal square-law.

total_dc_gain.description: Overall low-frequency open-loop voltage gain across both cascaded stages

equation.explanation: Product of the voltage gains of the two common-source stages.
equation.assumptions: Both stages operate in saturation with high output impedance at low frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Product of two CS stages with current source loads yielding ~70-80 dB total gain.

open_circuit_gain.description: Intrinsic open-circuit gain limit of single MOSFET stage

equation.explanation: Maximum achievable gain when the load impedance is much higher than the device's own output resistance.
equation.assumptions: Ideal infinite impedance current source load.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by single-transistor self-loading gm*ro on SKY130.

slew_rate.description: Maximum charging rate of the compensation/load capacitor by the class A current source

equation.explanation: In a class A stage, when the input device turns off, the load capacitance is charged solely by the fixed current source I_bias.
equation.assumptions: First stage driver completely turns off or steers all bias current into Cc1.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_bias = 20 uA, Cc1 = 1 pF -> SR = 20 uA / 1 pF = 20.0 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bias current set by SUB_1 is approximately 20 uA charging Cc1 = 1 pF.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Unity gain cross-over frequency set by the input transconductance and Miller compensation capacitor

equation.explanation: The Miller capacitor Cc1 splits poles and sets dominant unity-gain bandwidth via Miller integrator behavior.
equation.assumptions: Dominant pole approximation with pole splitting via Cc1 = 1 pF.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct result of input gm and 1 pF Miller capacitor.

rhp_zero_frequency.description: Right-half plane zero caused by feedforward path through the compensation capacitor

equation.explanation: Feedforward transmission through Cc1 to the second stage creates a RHP zero.
equation.assumptions: Unbuffered compensation capacitor connected between stage 1 output and stage 2 output.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Since stage 2 uses the same size and current as stage 1, gmb ≈ gma.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin of the loop gain at the unity-gain frequency

equation.explanation: Phase excess over -180 degrees at unity-gain frequency indicating stability.
equation.assumptions: Standard feedback stability metric evaluated at unity-gain cross-over.

sky130_expected.calculation: With dominant pole at ~10 kHz, output pole at f_p2 = g_mb / (2*pi*Cload) = 328.6u / (2*pi*0.1p) = 523 MHz, and RHP zero at 52 MHz: PM ≈ 180 - 90 - atan(52/523) - atan(52/52) = 90 - 5.7 - 45 = 39.3 deg.
sky130_expected.reasoning: RHP zero reduces phase margin unless nulling resistor is included.

dc_power_dissipation.description: Total quiescent DC power dissipation of the amplifier core and bias circuitry

equation.explanation: Product of supply voltage (1.8 V) and sum of all quiescent currents from VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: Stage 1: 20 uA, Stage 2: 20 uA, SUB_1 bias branches (~8 branches of 20 uA): ~200 uA total. P_DC = 1.8 V * 200 uA = 360 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Class A biasing requires continuous branch currents.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive ngspice testbench measuring DC operating point, power, low-frequency gains, unity-gain frequency, phase margin, and transient slew rate for the self-biased amplifier.
